tools.description: Open the Oasis WebUI form to add a Wi-Fi access point configuration. The band argument must be exactly 2G or 5G. The tool returns an error if no radio for the requested band is configured. This tool does not modify Wi-Fi settings directly.

properties.name: band
properties.description: Wi-Fi band: exactly 2G for 2.4 GHz or 5G for 5 GHz.

tools.name: add_wifi_config

tools.description: Open the Oasis WebUI form to remove an existing Wi-Fi access point configuration. This tool takes no arguments and does not modify Wi-Fi settings directly.
tools.name: delete_wifi_config

tools.description: Advanced/diagnostic tool: list the raw wireless interface names on this device (e.g. wlan0, phy0-ap0). Only use this if the user explicitly asks for low-level interface names or Wi-Fi diagnostics. To scan for nearby networks, use wifi_scan with a band instead - it no longer requires an interface name.
tools.name: get_active_wlan_if_list

tools.description: List wireless UCI configuration and runtime status without exposing Wi-Fi credentials.
tools.name: get_wifi_config

tools.description: Open the Oasis WebUI form to edit existing Wi-Fi access point settings. This tool takes no arguments and does not modify Wi-Fi settings directly.
tools.name: update_wifi_config

tools.description: Scan for nearby Wi-Fi networks on a given band. The band argument must be exactly 2G or 5G.

properties.name: band
properties.description: Wi-Fi band: exactly 2G for 2.4 GHz or 5G for 5 GHz.

tools.name: wifi_scan
